instructions: This server exposes the existing name-based tools plus 62 clickup_* compatibility tool contracts. Call clickup_get_schema for exact support and public-API gaps before assuming official-plugin parity. Use workspaces (team mode) or clickup_get_workspace_members to verify the account scope. Read the bundled clickup-team://skill resource for workflows. Use clickup_get_operators before bulk execution. Never retry an ambiguous write automatically. Ask before irreversible changes and pass confirm:true only after approval. No reminder read/update, Doc-page attachment signing, private cross-asset search, or private Unified API access is implied. Use workspaces to list authorized ClickUp workspaces. Pass workspace_id to select a workspace. Every action uses your own ClickUp permissions. Ask the user before destructive actions and pass confirm: true only after approval.

tools.name: workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces authorized by your own ClickUp account and the default for this connection.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find tasks anywhere in the workspace. Everything takes human names, not IDs: scope="Cavalry/Findings", assignee="Ben" or "me", status="in progress". Omit scope to search the whole workspace. Returns a compact table. NOTE: text= is matched client-side over the tasks actually scanned (ClickUp has no server-side task search), and the reply always states the coverage — narrow with scope/status/assignee for a complete answer over a large workspace.

scope.description: List or space: name, "Space/Folder/List" path, or ID. Omit = whole workspace.

assignee.description: Usernames, emails, or "me". Unresolvable names raise rather than return empty.

due.description: overdue | today | tomorrow | week | month | none | YYYY-MM-DD | A..B

text.description: Case-insensitive substring of the task name

view.description: Run a saved ClickUp View by name instead of building filters by hand

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

blocks.description: Task IDs that are blocked by this task

move_to.description: Destination list. Moves are real when the "Tasks in Multiple Lists" ClickApp is enabled — status is preserved and remapped to the destination, and subtasks follow their parent. With it off ClickUp returns 200 and silently does nothing, so every move is verified by read-back and the call fails loudly if it did not take.

tools.name: clickup_filter_tasks
tools.description: Retrieve tasks with combined filters (tags, lists, folders, spaces, statuses, assignees, due date range, completion date range, custom field values). Multiple values within a filter use OR logic; across filters, AND logic applies (custom_fields entries also AND together). Best for filtering tasks by structured field values. For text/keyword search across all workspace content, use search instead. Custom field filters need field IDs — discover them with clickup_get_custom_fields. Results are paginated at 100 tasks per page: the response includes has_more and next_page, and when has_more is true you MUST call again with page set to next_page (repeating until has_more is false) to retrieve every matching task — a single call is not guaranteed to be complete. Assignees must be numeric user IDs — use clickup_resolve_assignees to convert names/emails/"me". Date filters use YYYY-MM-DD. For a single task by ID, use clickup_get_task.

assignees.description: Filter by assignee user IDs. Multiple IDs use OR logic. Use clickup_resolve_assignees to convert names/emails/"me" first.

field_id.description: Custom field ID. Discover fields with clickup_get_custom_fields — one unrecognized field_id makes the API silently drop ALL custom field filters in the call and return unfiltered results. Formula, location, button, votes, signature, rollup, progress, and app fields cannot be filtered at all (any operator errors).

operator.description: On text fields '=' means contains and '==' exact match; on single-value non-text fields (number, money, date, rating, checkbox, dropdown) use '=' or '!=' (exact) — '==' and '!==' only work on text fields. <, <=, >, >=, RANGE order numbers/dates. Multi-value fields (labels, people, relationships) require ANY/ALL/NOT ANY/NOT ALL, with a non-empty JSON array value. IS NULL/IS NOT NULL match unset/set fields.

value.description: Filter value as a string. Omit for IS NULL/IS NOT NULL. Formats: text as-is; dropdown: option UUID, or the option's orderindex when the field's type_config.options is present (those legacy dropdowns store numeric values); number/money/rating: '42'; date: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (auto-converted to a timestamp for <, <=, >, >=, RANGE; date-only values resolve to 00:00 in your timezone); RANGE: JSON array of two numbers/dates (e.g. '[1, 5]'); ANY/ALL/NOT ANY/NOT ALL: JSON array — labels: option UUIDs, people: numeric user IDs, task/list relationships: task IDs (e.g. '["uuid1","uuid2"]'). For = or != on Date fields pass a millisecond epoch; date strings auto-convert only for the ordering operators.

custom_fields.description: Filter by custom field values. Entries combine with AND (and with all other filters).

date_closed_from.description: Filter tasks completed on or after. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

date_closed_to.description: Filter tasks completed on or before. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

due_date_from.description: Filter tasks with due date on or after. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

due_date_to.description: Filter tasks with due date on or before. Format: YYYY-MM-DD

folder_ids.description: Filter by Folder IDs. Multiple IDs use OR logic (matches tasks in ANY of the specified folders).

list_ids.description: Filter by List IDs. Multiple IDs use OR logic (matches tasks in ANY of the specified lists).

order_by.description: Sort results by field. Default direction is descending — newest first for created/updated. Set reverse: true for ascending (oldest first).

page.description: 0-indexed page number. Each page returns up to 100 tasks. When a response has has_more=true, request the next page using its next_page value, and keep going until has_more=false to retrieve every matching task.

reverse.description: Sort ascending (oldest first) instead of the default descending (newest first). Leave unset/false to get the most recently created/updated tasks first.

space_ids.description: Filter by Space IDs. Multiple IDs use OR logic (matches tasks in ANY of the specified spaces).

statuses.description: Filter by task status names. Multiple statuses use OR logic (matches tasks with ANY of the specified statuses).

tags.description: Filter by tag names. Multiple tags use OR logic (matches tasks with ANY of the specified tags).

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace ID. Defaults to the workspace chosen when connecting.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace ID. Defaults to the workspace chosen when connecting.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

tools.name: clickup_update_folder
tools.description: Update a ClickUp folder. Requires folder_id + at least one update field (name/override_statuses). Only specified fields updated. Changes apply to all lists in folder. If you need to get a folder ID from a folder name, use clickup_get_folder first.

folder_id.description: ID of the folder to update.

override_statuses.description: Whether to override space statuses with folder-specific statuses.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace ID. Defaults to the workspace chosen when connecting.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

tools.name: clickup_update_list
tools.description: Update a ClickUp list. Requires list_id + at least one update field (name/content/status). Only specified fields updated. If you need to get a list ID from a list name, use clickup_get_list first.

content.description: New description or content for the list.

list_id.description: ID of the list to update.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace ID. Defaults to the workspace chosen when connecting.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

tools.name: clickup_update_reminder
tools.description: UNAVAILABLE: ClickUp public v2/v3 specifications expose no reminder-update endpoint. This compatibility contract returns an explicit error.

due_date.description: New due date in YYYY-MM-DD format or date-time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format (e.g., '2025-12-31' or '2025-12-31 14:30'). Uses your user timezone.

is_completed.description: Set to true to mark the reminder as completed, false to mark as incomplete.

reminder_id.description: The unique identifier (KSUID) of the reminder to update.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace ID. Defaults to the workspace chosen when connecting.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

tools.name: clickup_update_task
tools.description: Update task properties. Requires task_id and at least one field to change. Supports assignees (user IDs, emails, usernames, or "me"), custom fields as [{id, value}], and task_type by name (or 'none' to reset).

assignees.description: Array of assignee user IDs. Use clickup_resolve_assignees to convert emails, usernames, or "me" to user IDs if needed.

value.description: Value for the custom field. Pass as a string — the format depends on the field type: text/url/email: the value directly. phone: must be a valid phone number in international format (e.g. '+1 234 567 8901'). dropdown: the option UUID. number/money/rating: the number as a string (e.g. '42'). date: a date string in YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format (auto-converted to timestamp). checkbox/button: 'true' or 'false'. labels: JSON array of UUIDs (e.g. '["uuid1","uuid2"]'). relationships/people/files: JSON with add/rem arrays (e.g. '{"add":["id1"],"rem":["id2"]}'). progress: JSON with current value (e.g. '{"current":50}'). location: JSON with location object (e.g. '{"location":{"lat":-28,"lng":153},"formatted_address":"..."}').

custom_fields.description: Array of custom field values to set on the task. Each object must have an 'id' and 'value' property.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. Pass 'none' to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.

priority.description: Set priority, or 'none' to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. Pass 'none' to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.

status.description: New status (must be valid for the task's list).

task_id.description: Task ID (supports custom IDs like 'DEV-1234')

task_type.description: To change the task type, pass the type name as a string (e.g., 'Bug', 'Feature', 'Milestone'). The type must exist in the workspace. To revert to the default 'Task' type, pass 'none'. Omit entirely to leave unchanged.

workspace_id.description: Authorized workspace ID. Defaults to the workspace chosen when connecting.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user explicitly approves an irreversible deletion.

unavailable.clickup_search_reminders: ClickUp public v2/v3 specifications expose no reminder-list endpoint.
unavailable.clickup_update_reminder: ClickUp public v2/v3 specifications expose no reminder-update endpoint.
unavailable.clickup_list_document_page_attachments: Public attachments API supports tasks and file custom fields, not Doc pages.
unavailable.clickup_download_document_page_attachmen: No public API for Doc page attachment lookup and signed downloads.

limitations.clickup_search: Partial parity: public task and Doc-name search only. Unsupported asset types and filters fail explicitly. Coverage is returned with every page.
limitations.clickup_create_reminder: Experimental: uses the existing repository create-only reminder integration. This endpoint is absent from the public OpenAPI specification and may be unavailable.
limitations.clickup_download_task_attachment: Partial parity: returns attachment URLs from accessible task metadata. It cannot mint the official plugin private, short-lived download URLs.
limitations.clickup_execute_operator: Public API implementation of five bulk workflows. Sequential per-item results, not the official private Unified API. Quill descriptions and group assignees are unavailable. query supports JMESPath.
limitations.clickup_get_operators: Lists this server public-API bulk adapters. These are not upstream private Unified API routes.
limitations.clickup_request_attachment_upload: Available in team HTTP mode only. Uses a one-time server upload ticket, never exposes the ClickUp OAuth credential.
